document_basis.application: Buyer name/address/TIN depend on invoice type; do not require every customer to have a TIN.
Customer PII and profile change history encrypted; search uses merchant-scoped HMAC prefix indexes.
Prevent exact duplicate imports; preserve original invoice snapshots, confidentiality, access and portability. No customer delete endpoint or retention purge was introduced.

design_adjustments: Reused the existing official NUERS logo, Philippine skyline/flag header and Lucide icons; no new generated raster asset was necessary.
Reference layout, six KPI cards, filters, directory table, actions, segment donut, profile summary and compliance card implemented with responsive readable typography.
Verified customers replaced by Details Reviewed, which records merchant review rather than BIR verification.
Segments are exclusive business/retail/walk-in categories; VIP is a separate group and is not double-counted.

Lifetime sales replaced by Recorded Invoice Total: canonical linked primary invoice amounts; drafts, supplementary receipts/payments, adjustments, cancelled and duplicate document identities excluded. This is not a tax filing or a financial reconciliation certification.
Reference Transactions and Credit / Debit Notes navigation were not reintroduced; document work remains under Invoices & Receipts.
features: Encrypted previous/current profile history and reasons
Word-prefix and formatted-TIN/phone search via indexed hashes
Customer type/status/group/own branch/date-from/date-to filters and pagination
Atomic UTF-8 CSV import: 2 MB, 500 rows, validation and exact duplicate rejection
Filtered CSV export, formula-safe cells, 10,000 profile limit and audit
Explicit association with own historical documents; no silent name/TIN merging
Customer-to-invoice prefill, ownership/active-profile checks and snapshot-preserving forward links
Existing tenant portability includes usable customer profiles, relationships and encrypted history

browser: Synthetic profile created and persisted across reload
Filtered search returned the saved profile
Customer profile and encrypted revision history metadata displayed
Create Invoice opened with correct buyer name/email prefilled
390px viewport equals document width; no horizontal page overflow

notes: Synthetic customer profiles were created only in the isolated SQLite QA database. The main customer registry starts empty. Existing document buyers can be reviewed explicitly before adding them.
No historical invoice/receipt data changed, actual invoice issued, customer email sent or disruptive load/security test performed.
Customer management and its review labels do not establish BIR registration, accreditation or production EIS acceptance.
